reviews.review: A very enjoyable game! This isn't going to make you never want to play Left 4 Dead ever again, but it is very much worth its price tag (especially on sale). I found the AI to be less annoying than in Left 4 Dead, and I think the gun-play was decent, the game ran pretty well on my mid-range build from 2021/2022ish. I really enjoyed how some of the levels look, the first episode really clicked with me visually for some reason. I would say that Left 4 Dead has better levels, but I mean this is a game made by a small team, not Valve. I think too many people come in expecting a Left 4 Dead killer, and then when it's not better than a triple-a game, they get disappointed. This is in many ways like Left 4 Dead, but it does some things different, some things worse, some things better, and for 2.50 on sale or 10 bucks off sale, it's a fun time. This is a game that I will be coming back to, like Left 4 Dead 2, and such. The game lacks polish in places, it feels a bit unfinished, but it's a good time, I hope it'll get updates in the future.
